text:
marta: @here okay non-work brain teaser — if you had an entire year with zero work obligations to learn ONE hobby from scratch, what would you pick? no repeats, convince us why.

alex: Guitar. Always wanted to learn properly, not just the three chords. Imagine a small Redwood open-mic night. :guitar:

jim: Pottery. Make your own mugs and grief therapy via clay. also fits well with rainy seattle vibes.

olivia: Japanese language + travel immersion. One year of classes + living in Kyoto would be a dream. 🇯🇵

noah: Rock climbing (outdoor). Bouldering, trad, the whole circus. Get strong, meet cool people, spend weekends in the mountains.

marta: Rules: must be something you DON'T already do regularly (so no yoga for me, sadly 😬). Bonus points if there's a tangible product at the end.

alex: Would baking count? Like going full artisan sourdough + viennoiserie apprenticeship level. I want croissants that aren't disasters. 😅

olivia: baking totally counts. also i'd be here for pastry swaps.

sarah: I'm already doing film photography and a darkroom course — highly recommend for people who like slow, tactile hobbies. one year really lets you build a portfolio.

jim: story time: took one pottery class and my 'bowl' looked like a pancake. still displayed it like modern art.

lunchbot: Reminder: team lunch orders close Friday at 11:30am! :pizza:

marta: This is great. Maybe we should run a poll but I like the chat vibes better. If anyone wants pairing buddies: @olivia i'll study japanese vocab together.

noah: @marta weekend belays? I'm down to introduce people to the gym. :raised_hands:

alex: Amp/gear owners — would anyone host a beginner guitar jam night?

olivia: Shared resource: https://youtu.be/dummy-beginners-guide — nice beginner roadmap for languages (videos + immersion tips).

sarah: anyone tried combining hobbies? like pottery + photography project? would love collabs.

marta: Love it. Okay team, keep the ideas coming. Also: who else is secretly into something weird (cat tax photos, niche board games, competitive beekeeping)?

jim: competitive beekeeping — new company hobby? :honey_pot:

alex: I'll bring my uke to the next social.

olivia: If enough people pick language + music we should plan a cross-hobby showcase next quarter.

marta: Thread closed for now — will check back in a week with a silly poll. Thanks y'all for the inspo!
